title: Missing controller state is unknown, never empty or complete
summary: When a controller's state store is missing, corrupt or silently unreadable, dependent mutation is held and state is reconstructed from authoritative records; absence of state is reported as unknown, never as an empty or finished project.

protected.asset: Continuity of long-running automated work across restarts and failures
protected.failure: A state read failure is interpreted as 'nothing pending' or 'all complete', so finished work is revived or live work is silently dropped.

rationale: Unattended controllers wake, read state and act. A failed read is itself a signal: the correct product is an explicit unknown status that holds dependent mutation and triggers reconstruction from authoritative records — acceptance receipts and mandate revisions — never inference from absence. One collector's empty result is evidence about that collector, not about the world; it must not silently zero a dashboard, and a failed one-shot collection must not be projected onto the production controller without a separate check.

variants.description: A state read failure yields an explicit unknown status; dependent mutation is held; reconstruction uses authoritative records only, and an unresolvable mode escalates once.
A collector that fails marks its output as failed-collection instead of emitting a legitimately empty dataset, so downstream consumers cannot mistake the two.

verification.method: In a disposable environment, point a controller at a deliberately unreadable state store and confirm it reports unknown and performs no dependent mutation; then restore and confirm reconstruction from authoritative records.
verification.evidence: The induced failure, the reported unknown status, the absence of dependent writes during the failure, and the reconstruction trail.

rollback.method: Remove the gate to restore fail-open behaviour; the gate itself writes no state.
rollback.safety: Holding mutation on unknown state is always safe to keep; lifting the hold requires the reconstructed state, not a timeout.

failure_modes: An empty collection result is published as an empty inventory.
Missing state resurrects already-completed work as if it were pending.
Missing state silently cancels live work as if it were finished.

hermes_versions.notes: Operational practice control: applies to any unattended controller with a state store; the range records the builds whose state surfaces the procedure was read against.

last_verification.notes: General operational synthesis from recorded practice with private detail removed; no specific public incident is claimed.

references: General operational synthesis from recorded practice; no publicly verifiable incident is cited.
